name: playbook-v02
description: PLAYBOOK: reprodutor pessoal de audiolivros sem servidor obrigatório

scripts.build:windows: npm run build:web && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.build:mac: npm run build:web && electron-builder --mac dmg --publish never
scripts.build:linux: npm run build:web && electron-builder --linux AppImage --publish never
scripts.mobile:android:init: npm run build:web && npx cap add android
scripts.mobile:ios:init: npm run build:web && npx cap add ios
scripts.mobile:sync: npm run build:web && npx cap sync
